question: NVFP4 量化在 V100 上的计算路径：由于 V100 硬件不支持原生 FP4 计算，vLLM 需将 FP4 权重反量化为 FP16 或使用 INT8/FP8 近似路径，导致有效算力从 156 TFLOPS 降至 ~78 TFLOPS (INT8) 或更低，且引入额外的反量化计算开销 (Dequantization Overhead) 约为 5-10% 的总计算时间 [待核验]

sources.snippet: NVFP4 is NVIDIA's 4-bit float format (E2M1 payloads + E8M0 per-block scales, 0.5625 bytes/param) designed for Blackwell's FP4 tensor cores. A V100 (sm_70) has none of that hardware. This repository is the complete research record of doing it anyway — in software — and making it fast: A full quantization pipeline that packs Qwen-family HF weights into an NVFP4 container (nvfp4_packed.bin
